label: Matt 16:1
text: The Pharisees and Sadducees came, and testing him, asked him to show them a sign from heaven.

label: Matt 16:2
text:
But he answered them,
“When it is evening, you say, ‘It will be fair weather, for the sky is red.’

variants.note: The fetched Wikipedia 'Textual variants in the Gospel of Matthew' lists 'Text omitted — א B V X Y Γ ...' for Matthew 16:2-3: the whole weather-saying is absent from Sinaiticus (א) and Vaticanus (B) and a series of later uncials and minuscules.

variants.reading: The weather saying present (the WEB text)
variants.note: The article lists the saying in C, (D), F, G, H, (K), L, (N), O, (W), Δ, Θ, f1 and many minuscules and versions - witnesses that are not manuscript nodes of this graph, so attested_by is left empty.

label: Matt 16:3
text: In the morning, ‘It will be foul weather today, for the sky is red and threatening.’ Hypocrites! You know how to discern the appearance of the sky, but you can’t discern the signs of the times!

label: Matt 16:4
text:
An evil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign, and there will be no sign given to it, except the sign of the prophet Jonah.”
He left them, and departed.

label: Matt 16:5
text: The disciples came to the other side and had forgotten to take bread.

label: Matt 16:6
text:
Jesus said to them,
“Take heed and beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”

label: Matt 16:7
text: They reasoned among themselves, saying, “We brought no bread.”

label: Matt 16:8
text:
Jesus, perceiving it, said,
“Why do you reason among yourselves, you of little faith, ‘because you have brought no bread?’

label: Matt 16:9
text: Don’t you yet perceive, neither remember the five loaves for the five thousand, and how many baskets you took up?

label: Matt 16:10
text: Nor the seven loaves for the four thousand, and how many baskets you took up?

label: Matt 16:11
text: How is it that you don’t perceive that I didn’t speak to you concerning bread? But beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”

label: Matt 16:12
text: Then they understood that he didn’t tell them to beware of the yeast of bread, but of the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.

label: Matt 16:13
text:
Now when Jesus came into the parts of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying,
“Who do men say that I, the Son of Man, am?”

label: Matt 16:14
text: They said, “Some say John the Baptizer, some, Elijah, and others, Jeremiah, or one of the prophets.”

label: Matt 16:15
text:
He said to them,
“But who do you say that I am?”

label: Matt 16:16
text: Simon Peter answered, “You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.”

label: Matt 16:17
text:
Jesus answered him,
“Blessed are you, Simon Bar Jonah, for flesh and blood has not revealed this to you, but my Father who is in heaven.

label: Matt 16:18
text:
I also tell you that you are Peter,
and on this rock

I will build my assembly, and the gates of Hades
will not prevail against it.

label: Matt 16:19
text: I will give to you the keys of the Kingdom of Heaven, and whatever you bind on earth will have been bound in heaven; and whatever you release on earth will have been released in heaven.”

variants.note: The fetched Wikipedia 'Textual variants in the Gospel of Matthew' lists κλειδας ('keys') in א* B* L W, against κλεις ('key', singular) in א2 Bc C D f1 f13 and the majority text. The WEB reads the plural 'keys'.
Listed in the article for א2, Bc, C, D, f1, f13 and the majority text; these witnesses are not manuscript nodes of this graph, so attested_by is left empty.

label: Matt 16:20
text: Then he commanded the disciples that they should tell no one that he was Jesus the Christ.

label: Matt 16:21
text: From that time, Jesus began to show his disciples that he must go to Jerusalem and suffer many things from the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and the third day be raised up.

label: Matt 16:22
text: Peter took him aside, and began to rebuke him, saying, “Far be it from you, Lord! This will never be done to you.”

label: Matt 16:23
text:
But he turned, and said to Peter,
“Get behind me, Satan! You are a stumbling block to me, for you are not setting your mind on the things of God, but on the things of men.”

label: Matt 16:24
text:
Then Jesus said to his disciples,
“If anyone desires to come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.

label: Matt 16:25
text: For whoever desires to save his life will lose it, and whoever will lose his life for my sake will find it.

label: Matt 16:26
text: For what will it profit a man, if he gains the whole world, and forfeits his life? Or what will a man give in exchange for his life?

label: Matt 16:27
text: For the Son of Man will come in the glory of his Father with his angels, and then he will render to everyone according to his deeds.

label: Matt 16:28
text: Most certainly I tell you, there are some standing here who will in no way taste of death, until they see the Son of Man coming in his Kingdom.”

label: Red-sky weather wisdom: at middle latitudes prevailing winds travel west to east, so a red evening sky precedes fair weather and a red morning sky warns of storms
method: Atmospheric optics and prevailing-wind meteorology: trapped particles scatter blue light in a stable air mass; high pressure from the west gives an evening red glow and stable weather, a morning red glow precedes an approaching low-pressure system

label: Pharisees and Sadducees asked for a sign from heaven
statement: Pharisees and Sadducees came and, testing Jesus, asked him to show them a sign from heaven.

label: Pharisees and Sadducees as two distinct Jewish parties
statement: Pharisees and Sadducees were two distinct Jewish parties active in this period.

label: Weather read from the colour of the sky
statement: Fair weather was read from a red evening sky and foul weather from a red and threatening morning sky ('red sky at night').

label: The sign of the prophet Jonah
statement: An evil and adulterous generation seeks a sign, and no sign would be given to it except the sign of the prophet Jonah.

label: The disciples forgot to take bread
statement: Crossing to the other side, the disciples had forgotten to take bread.

label: The leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees
statement: Jesus warned, 'Beware of the yeast (leaven) of the Pharisees and Sadducees'; the disciples understood leaven as figurative for their teaching.

label: Recall of the five loaves for the five thousand
statement: Jesus recalled the five loaves for the five thousand and the baskets taken up (a recall of the ch 14 feeding).

label: Recall of the seven loaves for the four thousand
statement: Jesus recalled the seven loaves for the four thousand and the baskets taken up (the ch 15 feeding).

label: Jesus came into the parts of Caesarea Philippi
statement: Jesus came into the parts (region) of Caesarea Philippi, the city Philip the Tetrarch refounded at Paneas (Banias) by the springs of the Jordan, with the Pan sanctuary and Herod's temple to Augustus.

label: 'Who do men say that I, the Son of Man, am?'
statement: At Caesarea Philippi Jesus asked his disciples, 'Who do men say that I, the Son of Man, am?'

label: Popular identifications: John the Baptist, Elijah, Jeremiah
statement: Some said John the Baptizer, some Elijah, and others Jeremiah or one of the prophets - redivivus and eschatological-expectation identifications.

label: Peter's confession at Caesarea Philippi
statement: Simon Peter answered, 'You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.'

label: Simon Bar Jonah
statement: Jesus blessed 'Simon Bar Jonah' - Simon Peter as son of Jonah.

label: 'You are Peter, and on this rock I will build my assembly'
statement: Jesus said, 'You are Peter (Petros), and on this rock (petra) I will build my assembly (ekklesia).'

label: The gates of Hades
statement: 'The gates of Hades will not prevail against it' - Hades as the abode of the dead.

label: The keys of the Kingdom of Heaven
statement: Jesus gave Simon Peter 'the keys of the Kingdom of Heaven'.

label: Binding and loosing
statement: 'Whatever you bind on earth will have been bound in heaven; and whatever you release on earth will have been released in heaven' - the rabbinic idiom of binding (forbidding) and loosing (permitting).

label: Suffering at Jerusalem from the elders, chief priests and scribes
statement: Jesus began to show his disciples that he must go to Jerusalem and suffer many things from the elders, chief priests and scribes, and be killed, and the third day be raised up.

label: 'Take up his cross'
statement: Whoever would come after Jesus must deny himself and take up his cross - crucifixion as a known death in the period.

label: The Son of Man coming in his Father's glory with his angels
statement: The Son of Man will come in the glory of his Father with his angels, and render to everyone according to his deeds.

label: Some standing here will see the Son of Man coming in his kingdom
statement: Some standing there would in no way taste of death until they see the Son of Man coming in his kingdom.
